claims.text: Obstructive HCM w persistent LVOTO Sx despite BB or NDHP CCB: add a myosin inhibitor (adults only), or disopyramide (w an AV-nodal blocker), or SRT @ experienced centers.
claims.quote: For patients with obstructive HCM who have persistent symptoms attributable to LVOTO despite beta blockers or nondihydropyridine calcium channel blockers, adding a myosin inhibitor (adult patients only), or disopyramide (in combination with an atrioventricular nodal blocking agent), or SRT performed at experienced centers, is recommended.
